overview.title: Empower Your Workspace with Premium
overview.description: Running operations on slow computers or unmanaged networking gear creates severe production lags and exposes your data to cyber risks. RCS Infra Tech acts as a single-source partner for IT hardware sourcing, configuration, and ongoing servicing. We procure desktops, travel laptops, interactive digital boards, rack servers, and network switches directly from global brand distributors. Every device is asset-tagged, pre-imaged with corporate security software, and backed by comprehensive onsite replacement warranties.

faqSection.title: IT Hardware Solutions & AMCs
faqSection.subtitle: Common answers regarding brand authorizations, warranty handling, bulk order timelines, and maintenance contracts.

items.question: Are all hardware products sourced directly from authorized brand distributors?
items.answer: Yes. RCS Infra Tech maintains partner relationships with major OEMs (Dell, HP, Lenovo, Cisco, BenQ, APC). All laptops, servers, panels, and parts are 100% genuine and carry full brand warranty certificates.

items.question: What is included in an Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) for hardware?
items.answer: Our hardware AMC includes periodic physical dustings, operating system health checks, temperature checks, antivirus updates, and immediate onsite troubleshooting with priority access to replacement parts.

items.question: Do you pre-load custom operating systems and security profiles on laptops?
items.answer: Yes. We operate a staging facility where we pre-install your choice of operating systems (Windows Pro, macOS, Linux), configure local user directories, pre-load corporate antivirus tools, and apply asset tracking tags.

items.question: What is the typical delivery timeline for bulk corporate laptop orders?
items.answer: Standard configurations are typically delivered and set up within 5 to 7 business days. Custom configurations (upgraded RAM, SSDs, or specialized server CPUs) depend on distributor stock and may take 10 to 14 business days.

items.question: How do you handle warranty replacements for failed components?
items.answer: Under our AMC or standard setup agreements, you contact our helpdesk first. We dispatch a technician to verify the failure. If it is under warranty, we coordinate directly with the OEM manufacturer to secure the replacement part.

items.question: Do you provide rental or leasing options for corporate office setups?
items.answer: Yes. We offer flexible leasing agreements for desktops, laptops, and networking switches for periods starting from 12 months up to 36 months, allowing you to reduce initial capital expenditure (CAPEX).
